question: Should `claws apply --yes` count as explicit acknowledgement for review-required ClawHub skill releases, or must Claw apply preserve the separate ClawHub acknowledgement?
rationale: Current main treats ClawHub risk acceptance as a distinct security decision; code review cannot safely redefine that consent boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve separate acknowledgement
options.body: Add a Claw apply acknowledgement flag or interactive callback and block review-required releases when it is absent.

options.title: Define `--yes` as trust consent
options.body: Explicitly document and test that non-interactive Claw apply accepts both Claw mutations and ClawHub release risk.

options.title: Defer ClawHub installs
options.body: Land only local and git skill support until the Claws RFC settles the trust boundary.

recommendation.title: Preserve separate acknowledgement
recommendation.body: Add a Claw apply acknowledgement flag or interactive callback and block review-required releases when it is absent.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected acknowledgement and trust contract appears to date to his merged ClawHub trust work.
